InWorldz Halcyon's compiler tables (data only)

What:   functions.json  every built-in function Halcyon's compiler knows:
                        name, return type, parameter types and names, and its
                        syscall number (531 functions)
        constants.json  every constant Halcyon's compiler knows: name, type,
                        value as Phlox stores it, and for integers the 32-bit
                        value a script sees ("int32") (775 constants)

From:   InWorldz.Phlox.dll, Halcyon's LSL compiler, as shipped in the lib
        folder of InWorldz Halcyon (github.com/InWorldz/halcyon, BSD 3-clause,
        Copyright (c) InWorldz Inc.). Phlox has no published source; the
        tables are its fields InWorldz.Phlox.Types.Defaults.SystemMethods and
        InWorldz.Phlox.Compiler.DefaultConstants.Constants, read by
        tools/halcyon_oracle/PhloxDump.cs. Nothing from the DLL is compiled
        into this module; these two files are facts about Halcyon's language
        (names, types, numbers) used to build the function index.

Why:    A script written for InWorldz compiled against these tables. Where
        they differ from what the C# function bodies (LSLSystemAPI.cs) say,
        these are what the scripts saw: for example iwDeliverInventory returns
        an integer and iwGetLastOwner returns a key here.

Remake: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools\halcyon_oracle\build.ps1
        (rewrites both files; see tools/halcyon_oracle/README.md)

Written 2026-11-14 from the Halcyon copy at
I:\Open Sim Back ups\HalcyonGrid\lib\InWorldz.Phlox.dll (700,928 bytes).
